# The Fleet venv (.venv-fleet): what `pip install -e .` of the submodule does
# not bring in and our Fleet-side scripts need (harness/run_fleet.py,
# fleet/tasks/kernel_tests.py, harness/compare.py, harness/measure.py).
#
# Fleet's own install_requires (repos/fleet-chiplet-megakernel/requirements.txt
# at 51dce4f) pins transformers==4.57.1, z3-solver==4.15, accelerate==1.8.0,
# torch>=2.4, cmake>=3.24, cython>=0.28 and tg4perfetto from git. transformers
# 4.57.1 cannot run the DeepSeek checkpoint's remote modeling code
# (DynamicCache.get_usable_length was removed after 4.46; verified locally,
# 17 harness tests fail under 4.57.1), and the day-1 Qwen3 smoke graph needs
# transformers >= 4.51. So the reference side lives in .venv with
# env/requirements.txt (4.46.3) and the Fleet side here; the two never share
# an interpreter. torch is installed from the ROCm wheel index by setup.sh
# before this file.
numpy
safetensors
huggingface_hub[cli]
cmake>=3.24
z3-solver==4.15
ninja
cython
pytest
graphviz            # a build requirement of Fleet's pyproject; needed because the build runs without isolation
hatchling           # build backend of tg4perfetto (installed from git by Fleet); needed without build isolation
